greeting.rho: Pick your circuit. I will watch and take notes.
greeting.zara: Pick a circuit! What will we find today?
greeting.liruf: Let's race. Pick a circuit and a driver!
greeting.dina: Take your time. Pick a circuit when ready.

item_hold.rho: I measured it. You kept your item and passed item boxes.
item_hold.zara: Hmm, you kept your item and rolled past the item boxes.
item_hold.liruf: You kept your item and zoomed past the boxes. Wow!
item_hold.dina: You held on to your item as you passed the boxes.

drift_patient.rho: I timed it. You waited for the big boost.
drift_patient.zara: Ooh, you waited and waited for the big boost!
drift_patient.liruf: You waited for the big boost. Whoosh!
drift_patient.dina: You took your time and waited for the big boost.

drift_early.rho: I counted. You let go of the boost early, again and again.
drift_early.zara: Hmm, you let go of the boost early, again and again.
drift_early.liruf: You let go of the boost early, again and again. Zip!
drift_early.dina: You let go of the boost early, again and again. No rush.

steady.rho: I compared your laps. They were close together.
steady.zara: Look at that, your laps were all close together!
steady.liruf: Your laps were all close together. Zoom, zoom, zoom!
steady.dina: Your laps were close together. Calm and even.

swingy.rho: I compared your laps. They changed a lot.
swingy.zara: Interesting, your laps changed a lot from one to the next.
swingy.liruf: Your laps changed a lot. Fast, slow, fast!
swingy.dina: Your laps changed a lot. Let's wonder why, no rush.

neutral.rho: Race done. I wrote down your laps.
neutral.zara: Race done! I already have ideas for the next one.
neutral.liruf: You raced. That was so fun to watch!
neutral.dina: You finished the race. Take a breath.

question.item_hold: Why did you keep the item?
question.drift_early: What made you let go early?

line.rho: We have raced a good while. A rest helps us think.
line.zara: Our brains worked hard. Let's rest them a bit!
line.liruf: Time for a snack and a stretch!
line.dina: You have raced for a while. Shall we rest a little?

limit.heading: All done for today
limit.body: Come back tomorrow for more racing.

ended.heading: Racing time is over
ended.body: Time to rest. See you soon.

offline.heading: No connection
offline.body: Check your internet, then try again.
